```{r}
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: FALSE

# Initial packages required (we'll be adding more)
library(tidyverse)
library(mdsr)# package associated with our MDSR book
library(lubridate)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(maps)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)

zillow_state <- read.csv("zillow_sf_statevalue.csv")
zillow_neighbor <- read.csv("zillow_sf_neighborhoodvalue2.csv")
mpls <- read_sf("mpls_neighbors.geojson")
```

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE

#cleaning state zillow data

zillow_state <- zillow_state |>
  select(RegionName, starts_with("X201"), starts_with("X202")) |> #filter to only include the state names and dates from 2010 to present 
  filter(RegionName != "District of Columbia")

#pivoting for easy date anaylsis 

zillow_long <- zillow_state |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "date",
    values_to = "homevalue"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = str_remove(date, "^X"),
    date = str_replace_all(date, "\\.", "-"),
    date = ymd(date),
    year = year(date)
  ) 

#average value for each year 
zillow_year <- zillow_long |>
  group_by(RegionName, year) |>
  summarize(avg_val = mean(homevalue), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(RegionName = str_to_lower(RegionName))
```

```{r}
#| include: FALSE

us_states <- map_data("state")

#joining state zillow and us states 

zillow_map <- us_states |>
  full_join(zillow_year, by = c("region" = "RegionName")) 
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
#| out-width: "80%"
#| echo: FALSE

zillow_map |>
  filter(year >= 2016) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) + 
    geom_polygon(
      aes(fill = avg_val), 
      color = "black", 
      linewidth = 0.1
    ) + 
    labs(fill = "avg_val") +
    coord_map() +  
    theme_void() +  
    scale_fill_viridis() +
    facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(title = "Average Value of Homes Across the United States", fill = "Average House Value ($)", subtitle = "Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) for single family homes.")
```

# Minneapolis Data (Categorical)

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE

# cleaning zillow neighborhood - to have average value for each neighborhood for the year 2026

zillow_mpls26 <- zillow_neighbor |>
  select(City, RegionName, starts_with("X2026")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "date",
    values_to = "homevalue"
  ) |>
  filter(City == "Minneapolis") |>
  mutate(
    date = str_remove(date, "^X"),
    date = str_replace_all(date, "\\.", "-"),
    date = ymd(date),
    year = year(date)
  ) |>
  group_by(RegionName, year) |>
  summarize(avg_val = mean(homevalue), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(RegionName = str_to_lower(RegionName),
         RegionName = recode(
           RegionName, 
           "east bank-nicollet island" = "nicollet island east bank",
           "fuller tangletown" = "tangletown",
           "northrup" = "northrop")
         )

#create a categorical variable for different values of houses
zillow_mpls26 <- zillow_mpls26 |>
  mutate(
    val_group = case_when(
      avg_val < 400000 ~ "Very Low",
      avg_val < 600000 ~ "Low",
      avg_val < 800000 ~ "Moderate",
      avg_val < 1000000 ~ "High",
      avg_val < 1200000 ~ "Very High",
      is.na(avg_val) ~ "No Data",
      TRUE ~ "Highest"
    ),
    val_group = factor(
      val_group,
      levels = c(
        "Very Low",
        "Low",
        "Moderate",
        "High",
        "Very High",
        "Highest",
        "No Data"
      )
    )
  )

```

```{r} 
#| echo: FALSE

mpls <- mpls |>
  mutate(BDNAME = str_to_lower(BDNAME),
         BDNAME = recode(
           BDNAME, 
           "bryn - mawr" = "bryn mawr",
           "cedar - isles - dean" = "cedar-isles-dean",
           "cedar riverside" = "cedar-riverside",
           "king field" = "kingfield",
           "lind - bohanon" = "lind-bohanon", 
           "mid - city industrial" = "mid-city industrial",
           "near - north" = "near north",
           "nicollet island - east bank" = "nicollet island east bank",
           "prospect park - east river road" = "prospect park",
           "st. anthony east" = "saint anthony east",
           "st. anthony west" = "saint anthony west",
           "steven's square - loring heights" = "stevens square",
           "sumner - glenwood" = "sumner-glenwood",
           "webber - camden" = "webber-camden",
           "willard - hay" = "willard hay"
           )
         ) 

#join the cleaned datasets (mpls and zillow_mpls26) 
mpls_map <- mpls |>
  left_join(
    zillow_mpls26,
    by = c("BDNAME" = "RegionName")
  ) |>
  mutate(BDNAME = str_to_upper(BDNAME))

```


```{r}
#| echo: FALSE

#labels
mpls_map <- mpls_map |>
  mutate(
    labels = glue(
      "<strong>{BDNAME}</strong><br/>
      Average Home Value: {dollar(avg_val)}<br/>
      Value Category: {val_group}"
    )
  )

labels <- lapply(mpls_map$labels, HTML)

#color pallate 
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c(
    "#440154",
    "#414487",
    "#2A788E",
    "#22A884",
    "#7AD151",
    "#FDE725",
    "grey80"
  ),
  domain = levels(mpls_map$val_group),
  ordered = TRUE
)

#plot
leaflet(mpls_map) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(val_group),
    weight = 2,
    color = "white",
    opacity = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,

    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 4,
      color = "#444",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),

    label = labels
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~val_group,
    title = "Average Home Value ($)",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
